name: Fire in the Hole xBomb

features.name: xBomb wilds
features.description: Exploding wilds destroy surrounding symbols and unlock rows.

features.name: Lucky Wagon spins
features.description: Persistent sticky multipliers on a fully unlocked grid.

review: Fire in the Hole xBomb is a mining-themed cascade game where xBomb wilds blow open extra rows. Its Lucky Wagon bonus has sticky multipliers that make late spins the most exciting. It strikes a good balance between Nolimit's extremes and a gameplay loop you can actually follow.
author: editorial-team
